## BuildConfig

BuildConfig is the source-tree configuration read from `ocidoc.yaml`,
`ocidoc.json`, or an explicitly selected configuration file.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 6 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### BuildConfig.schemaVersion

Key: `schemaVersion`

SchemaVersion is the build config format version. The only currently supported
value is `v1beta`.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Default | `v1beta` |
| Enum | `v1beta` |

### BuildConfig.annotations

Key: `annotations`

Annotations adds custom key/value pairs to the built artifact's root OCI
manifest. Keys starting with `org.ocidoc.` are reserved for OCIDoc itself and
rejected here.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | 1 structured example |
| Additional properties type | `string` |

### BuildConfig.components

Key: `components`

Components maps component names to their source selection and optional localized
document sets.

Built-in v1beta component names:

* documentation
* license
* changelog
* release-notes
* security
* contributing
* code-of-conduct
* support

Custom components are allowed when their names use the `x-` prefix, for example,
`x-api` or `x-runbooks`. Other names are rejected. At least one component with
one or more path rules is required. The same source file cannot be assigned to
more than one component.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | 1 structured example |
| Additional properties reference | [`ComponentBuildConfig`](#componentbuildconfig) (`#/$defs/ComponentBuildConfig`) |
| Property names type | `string` |
| Property names constraints | `pattern=^(?:documentation\|license\|changelog\|release-notes\|security\|contributing\|code-of-conduct\|support\|x-[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*)$` |
| Constraints | `minProperties=1` |

### BuildConfig.BuildSettings

Key: `settings`

Settings controls build-time behavior that does not change the resulting
artifact's logical identity: strict mode and component compression. Omit it to
use the documented defaults (strict mode off, gzip at level 6).

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`BuildSettings`](#buildsettings) (`#/$defs/BuildSettings`) |

### BuildConfig.DocumentSettings

Key: `document`

Document sets the built artifact's document identity (id and variant). Omit it
to build the default document.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`DocumentSettings`](#documentsettings) (`#/$defs/DocumentSettings`) |

### BuildConfig.ignore

Key: `ignore`

Ignore lists path rules excluded from every component, applied after component
matching. A rule prefixed with `!` is a negation: it restores a path an earlier
ignore rule would otherwise have excluded. Ignore rules are useful for
repository metadata or generated files that match a broad component rule.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `string` |
| Items examples | `/.git/**` |

## ComponentBuildConfig

ComponentBuildConfig selects one component's source files and optional localized
document sets.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### ComponentBuildConfig.paths

Key: `paths`

Path: [`components`](#buildconfigcomponents).`[]`.`paths`

Paths selects this component's files from the source tree.

Rules are repository-root-relative and normally begin with `/`. Glob patterns
are supported, and a rule beginning with `!` excludes a previously matched path.

These rules select the component's complete file set, including assets. Locale
rules below classify only its document files.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | yes |
| Items type | `string` |
| Constraints | `minItems=1` |

### ComponentBuildConfig.entrypoint

Key: `entrypoint`

Path: [`components`](#buildconfigcomponents).`[]`.`entrypoint`

Entrypoint overrides automatic detection of this component's primary file. The
path is root-relative and may begin with `/` in build configuration. It must
resolve to a file selected by Paths. Omit it to use deterministic
component-specific detection, such as `README.md` for documentation.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

### ComponentBuildConfig.locales

Key: `locales`

Path: [`components`](#buildconfigcomponents).`[]`.`locales`

Locales maps locale keys to path rules selecting this component's localized
documents.

Locale keys are opaque identifiers such as `en` or `ru` and are local to this
component; the same key may select different files in different components.

Locale rules never add files to the component and cannot select files owned
elsewhere. The default locale is optional; when omitted, renderers use the first
locale in sorted key order.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Required | no |
| Additional properties reference | [`BuildLocaleConfig`](#buildlocaleconfig) (`#/$defs/BuildLocaleConfig`) |

## BuildLocaleConfig

BuildLocaleConfig selects one component's document files for one locale.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### BuildLocaleConfig.default

Key: `default`

Path: [`components`](#buildconfigcomponents).`[]`.[`locales`](#componentbuildconfiglocales).`[]`.`default`

Default marks the preferred fallback locale for the component. At most one
locale per component may set it. It affects renderer fallback and the fallback
information stored in artifact metadata, not component ownership.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `boolean` |
| Required | no |

### BuildLocaleConfig.entrypoint

Key: `entrypoint`

Path: [`components`](#buildconfigcomponents).`[]`.[`locales`](#componentbuildconfiglocales).`[]`.`entrypoint`

Entrypoint overrides automatic selection of this locale's primary document. The
path is root-relative and may begin with `/` in build configuration. It must be
one of the documents selected by this locale's Paths.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

### BuildLocaleConfig.paths

Key: `paths`

Path: [`components`](#buildconfigcomponents).`[]`.[`locales`](#componentbuildconfiglocales).`[]`.`paths`

Paths selects this component's document files for the locale.

Rules are evaluated only against documents already owned by the parent
component. Assets and source files are not locale members.

An empty match is a warning by default and an error in strict mode.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | yes |
| Items type | `string` |
| Constraints | `minItems=1` |

## BuildSettings

BuildSettings holds optional build behavior that is not part of the resulting
artifact's identity.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 2 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### BuildSettings.CompressionSettings

Key: `compression`

Path: [`settings`](#buildconfigbuildsettings).`compression`

Compression selects how OCIDoc component layers are compressed. Omit it to use
the default: gzip at level 6.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`CompressionSettings`](#compressionsettings) (`#/$defs/CompressionSettings`) |

### BuildSettings.strict

Key: `strict`

Path: [`settings`](#buildconfigbuildsettings).`strict`

Strict rejects a build where a declared component or locale matches no files,
instead of only warning about it.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `boolean` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `false` |

## CompressionSettings

CompressionSettings selects the component layer compression algorithm and its
level on the shared OCIDoc compression scale.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 2 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### CompressionSettings.level

Key: `level`

Path: [`settings`](#buildconfigbuildsettings).[`compression`](#buildsettingscompressionsettings).`level`

Level controls the compression level used by the selected compressor. Higher
levels may reduce artifact size at the cost of additional CPU time during build.
Values above the selected compressor's maximum are accepted and clamped when the
final compression settings are applied.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `6` |
| Constraints | `minimum=0` |

### CompressionSettings.type

Key: `type`

Path: [`settings`](#buildconfigbuildsettings).[`compression`](#buildsettingscompressionsettings).`type`

Type selects the compression algorithm used for component layers.

* `gzip` is the default and has the broadest registry client support;
* `zstd` typically compresses faster and smaller at a comparable level, at the cost of less universal tooling support.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `gzip` |
| Enum | `gzip`, `zstd` |

## DocumentSettings

DocumentSettings sets the identity shown for the document artifact.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 2 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### DocumentSettings.id

Key: `id`

Path: [`document`](#buildconfigdocumentsettings).`id`

ID identifies this artifact among multiple documentation artifacts that may be
attached to the same subject.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `default` |

### DocumentSettings.variant

Key: `variant`

Path: [`document`](#buildconfigdocumentsettings).`variant`

Variant distinguishes multiple documents that share the same ID, for example
`operator` versus `user`. Omit it when only one variant of this document exists.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `operator` |

## Example yaml document

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocidoc/ocidoc-go/refs/heads/master/schema/build-config-v1beta.json

# SchemaVersion is the build config format version.
# The only currently supported value is `v1beta`.
# Default: v1beta
# Allowed values: v1beta
schemaVersion: v1beta
# Annotations adds custom key/value pairs to the built artifact's root OCI manifest.
# Keys starting with `org.ocidoc.` are reserved for OCIDoc itself and rejected here.
annotations:
  org.opencontainers.image.title: Project documentation
  org.opencontainers.image.version: 1.2.3
# Components maps component names to their source selection
# and optional localized document sets.
# Built-in v1beta component names:
#   - documentation
#   - license
#   - changelog
#   - release-notes
#   - security
#   - contributing
#   - code-of-conduct
#   - support
# Custom components are allowed when their names use the `x-` prefix,
# for example, `x-api` or `x-runbooks`. Other names are rejected.
# At least one component with one or more path rules is required.
# The same source file cannot be assigned to more than one component.
components:
  # ComponentBuildConfig selects one component's source files and optional localized document sets.
  changelog:
    # Paths selects this component's files from the source tree.
    # Rules are repository-root-relative and normally begin with `/`.
    # Glob patterns are supported, and a rule beginning with `!` excludes a previously matched path.
    # These rules select the component's complete file set, including assets.
    # Locale rules below classify only its document files.
    paths:
      - /CHANGELOG.md
  # ComponentBuildConfig selects one component's source files and optional localized document sets.
  documentation:
    # Paths selects this component's files from the source tree.
    # Rules are repository-root-relative and normally begin with `/`.
    # Glob patterns are supported, and a rule beginning with `!` excludes a previously matched path.
    # These rules select the component's complete file set, including assets.
    # Locale rules below classify only its document files.
    paths:
      - /README*.md
      - /docs/**
    # Entrypoint overrides automatic detection of this component's primary file.
    # The path is root-relative and may begin with `/` in build configuration.
    # It must resolve to a file selected by Paths.
    # Omit it to use deterministic component-specific detection, such as `README.md` for documentation.
    entrypoint: /README.md
    # Locales maps locale keys to path rules selecting this component's localized documents.
    # Locale keys are opaque identifiers such as `en` or `ru` and are local to this component;
    # the same key may select different files in different components.
    # Locale rules never add files to the component and cannot select files owned elsewhere.
    # The default locale is optional; when omitted, renderers use the first locale in sorted key order.
    locales:
      # BuildLocaleConfig selects one component's document files for one locale.
      en:
        # Default marks the preferred fallback locale for the component.
        # At most one locale per component may set it.
        # It affects renderer fallback and the fallback information stored in artifact metadata, not component ownership.
        default: true
        # Entrypoint overrides automatic selection of this locale's primary document.
        # The path is root-relative and may begin with `/` in build configuration.
        # It must be one of the documents selected by this locale's Paths.
        entrypoint: /README.md
        # Paths selects this component's document files for the locale.
        # Rules are evaluated only against documents already owned by the parent component.
        # Assets and source files are not locale members.
        # An empty match is a warning by default and an error in strict mode.
        paths:
          - /README.md
          - /docs/en/**
      # BuildLocaleConfig selects one component's document files for one locale.
      ru:
        # Entrypoint overrides automatic selection of this locale's primary document.
        # The path is root-relative and may begin with `/` in build configuration.
        # It must be one of the documents selected by this locale's Paths.
        entrypoint: /README.ru.md
        # Paths selects this component's document files for the locale.
        # Rules are evaluated only against documents already owned by the parent component.
        # Assets and source files are not locale members.
        # An empty match is a warning by default and an error in strict mode.
        paths:
          - /README.ru.md
          - /docs/ru/**
# Settings controls build-time behavior that does not change the resulting artifact's logical identity:
# strict mode and component compression.
# Omit it to use the documented defaults (strict mode off, gzip at level 6).
settings:
  # Compression selects how OCIDoc component layers are compressed.
  # Omit it to use the default: gzip at level 6.
  compression:
    # Level controls the compression level used by the selected compressor.
    # Higher levels may reduce artifact size at the cost of additional CPU time during build.
    # Values above the selected compressor's maximum are accepted and clamped
    # when the final compression settings are applied.
    # Default: 6
    level: 6
    # Type selects the compression algorithm used for component layers.
    #   - `gzip` is the default and has the broadest registry client support;
    #   - `zstd` typically compresses faster and smaller at a comparable level, at the cost of less universal tooling support.
    # Default: gzip
    # Allowed values: gzip, zstd
    type: gzip
  # Strict rejects a build where a declared component or locale matches no files, instead of only warning about it.
  # Default: false
  strict: false
# Document sets the built artifact's document identity (id and variant).
# Omit it to build the default document.
document:
  # ID identifies this artifact among multiple documentation artifacts that may be attached to the same subject.
  # Default: default
  id: default
  # Variant distinguishes multiple documents that share the same ID, for example `operator` versus `user`.
  # Omit it when only one variant of this document exists.
  # Example: operator
  variant: operator
# Ignore lists path rules excluded from every component, applied after component matching.
# A rule prefixed with `!` is a negation:
# it restores a path an earlier ignore rule would otherwise have excluded.
# Ignore rules are useful for repository metadata or generated files that match a broad component rule.
ignore:
  - /.git/**
```
